entities.summary: Ciletuh-Palabuhanratu Geopark is a national Geopark in Sukabumi Regency, West Java, Indonesia. It was recognized by UNESCO in 2015 as a national geopark, and it was proposed to become a member of the Global Geopark Network (GGN) to be recognized by UNESCO by 2017, but UNESCO finally made the park a part of the Global Geoparks Network in April 2018.
